text:
nina: Heads-up from Acme: they want a short, signed commitment for their private pilot. Key asks: p99 latency SLA, key management (HSM preferred), and a clear onramp calendar. Need reply today.

maria: copy. let's do a pragmatic staged offer. runtime/infra/security notes needed to finalize.

devon: tech reality: 250ms p99 for ~8k token chats is tough without reserved burst nodes + warm KV cache. Recommend pilot target p99 < 300ms, with GA goal 250ms after quantization + HSM rollout.

sasha: security: HSM procurement + attestation is ~3w. KMS-only pilot acceptable if Acme signs a limited risk acceptance and we scope data flows.

eli: infra: can carve a reserved pool in their region. I'll size it if devon confirms prewarm/node counts. Policy: explicit autoscale headroom and cost cap required.

maria: draft of customer reply: 1) Pilot SLA target: p99 < 300ms (measured across agreed traffic profile). 2) Encryption: KMS for pilot; HSM roadmap and ETA. 3) Rollback: if p99 > 350ms after mitigations, we failover to hosted endpoints. 4) Timeline: staging in 2w, security KMS signoff in 3w, HSM baseline ETA +4w after pilot start.

devon: add model ops task: run quick quantization experiments and a perf matrix (cold vs warm cache, batching windows, prewarm sizes). I'll post numbers in 48h.

sasha: send me the excerpt of the pilot contract and the risk waiver; i'll fast-track the checklist.

ops-bot: created runbook stub: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pilot-circuit-1887654321

legal-bot: reminder: include measurable SLA definition (how p99 is computed) and termination clause for unmet SLAs.

maria: i'll finalize the one-pager and @nina will review before send. Action items: eli open capacity PR with cost delta; devon run perf experiments; sasha prep risk waiver; legal to review SLA wording.

nina: thanks — I'll send a concise staged commitment: pilot-level SLA + HSM roadmap + explicit fallback. We'll loop back after the perf numbers. :thumbsup:
